market_summary: USD and BTC remain in pronounced downward expansion regimes below their respective session VWAP and Value Area Lows, but lack fresh RVOL confirmation at their session lows. Meanwhile, US100 has stretched into extreme upper ATR levels and Call Wall #1 within a positive dampening GEX regime, resulting in mean-reversion chop. High-probability edges are absent across all four assets at this juncture; holding is recommended.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (1.10760) and well below POC (1.10943). CVD is NEUTRAL (+355) with positive slope diverging from the downward impulse. During NEW_YORK_SESSION, price is trending strongly below declining VWAP (1.10822) and EMA50 (1.10826). Currently hovering right above the lower ATR band (1.10580) and Session Low (1.10533) with normal volume (RVOL 1.169, no yellow spike). No clean breakout or reversal confirmation; hold recommended.

Price is trading below VAL (1.32545) and POC (1.32731). CVD is BEARISH (-9,698) aligning with the downward break. In NEW_YORK_SESSION, price trades decisively under VWAP (1.32592) and EMA50 (1.32598). Candles are probing near the lower ATR band (1.32302) above Session Low (1.32210). Volume is moderate without RVOL > 2.0 yellow confirmation (RVOL 1.117). Risk of exhaustion bounce near session extremes warrants a hold.

Price is well above VAH (28218.78) and POC (28122.95). CVD is NEUTRAL (+2.81). In NEW_YORK_SESSION, market is in POSITIVE_DAMPENING GEX regime above Gamma Flip (28237.25). Price pushed beyond the upper ATR band (28444.0) to Session High (28550.97) and is now pulling back directly into Call Wall #1 (28433.62). Absence of RVOL yellow bars is expected on US100, but dampening regime and rejection directly at major Call Wall makes buying top-stretched and selling counter-trend; holding is prudent.
